extension.name: CiviVolunteer NG (Next Generation by Madgophers)
extension.description: INDEPENDENT FORK of CiviVolunteer with modern Angular architecture for CiviCRM 6.9+. Features conflict detection, removed legacy Backbone/Marionette dependencies, and simplified profile handling. NOT affiliated with official CiviVolunteer project. Use at your own risk.
extension.comments:
INDEPENDENT FORK maintained by Madgophers for CiviCRM 6.9.1+ compatibility.
Original CiviVolunteer developed by Ginkgo Street Labs and CiviCRM, LLC with contributions from the community.
Special thanks to: - Friends of Georgia State Parks & Historic Sites (funding initial release) - The Manhattan Neighborhood Network (funding 1.4 release) - All contributors to the original CiviVolunteer project
This fork adds: - Phase 0 (2025): Removed org.civicrm.angularprofiles dependency - Phase 1 (2025): Conflict detection for preventing double-booking - Phase 2 (2025): Complete Angular migration - all Backbone/Marionette code removed
Version 2.6.4 is a Development release for CiviCRM - Stand Alone - 6.9.1+ compatibility.
